marta: Retest next Tue 09:00 UTC. Need a compact evidence bundle: RBAC delta, audit slice, KMS usage manifest, session policy, and 1-line repros. Owners?

sam: I’ll do RBAC delta + terraform plan snippet. Will produce rbac.csv (principal,role,grant_ts,expires_ts,method) and terraform-plan.txt with change-id.

li: I’ll export audit-events-prod for 30m before/after window, gzip, sha256, presign URL. Will scrub IPs and include checksum.

ellen: KMS: provide key-usage manifest (key_id,op,ts,principal) + HMAC. No plaintext CMKs.

pen-test-bot: Upload hook will verify sha256 and allowed mime. Manifest.sig required. :white_check_mark:

marta: Great. File names: 4923456789/rbac.csv, audit.gz, kms-manifest.json, session-policy.json, manifest.json. Closing and attaching to ticket.
